records.subject: Welcome aboard, Silver Collective
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Silver Collective* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero engagement: no reply to either outreach (email:cfdce287, email:23e0d476), no tickets, no project, no invite. Accounts silent through the first week rarely self-activate; 8 days left on an active Pro plan leaves some chance someone returns, so not negligible.

draft.subject: A quick hand getting your first Wrenfield project up
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

I wanted to check in now that Silver Collective has had a week with Wrenfield. Nothing's moved in the workspace yet, which usually just means the week got busy.

When you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'll walk through setting up one real project with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Priya
